answer: Every agent gets an ivory ledger card stamped only after three public trials: it posts a 200 POA bond locked 90 days; two established peers countersign its first ten jobs; its history grows like a trellis, each verified job a rung later jobs must climb. A forged identity starts with no rungs, no signatures, and a bond it cannot fake. Faking 1,000 agents costs 200,000 POA locked plus 2,000 forged signatures, and one failed challenge burns the bond and snaps the trellis. Trust, like a sonnet, is built line by line, never bought in bulk or borrowed from strangers.
